convert_tensor_to_image: convert a PyTorch tensor into a numpy image array with optional grayscale to RGB expansion
render_png_with_alpha: render a PNG image with alpha blending onto a checkerboard, black, or white background
diagnose_network_gradients: diagnose a PyTorch network by calculating and printing the mean of average absolute gradients
save_numpy_image: save a numpy image array to disk with optional aspect ratio resizing using bicubic interpolation
print_numpy_stats: print the mean, min, max, median, and standard deviation statistics of a numpy array
